name: Maximilian
title: High Priest

villagemaster/30120.htm.text: High Priest Maximilian: Pleased to meet you. I am High Priest Maximilian of this temple, may Einhasad's light comfort your soul's distress. Why have you come here, to the heart of our faith?

links.text: Listen to information about second class transfer.

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30120-01.htm.text: High Priest Maximilian: By the grace of Einhasad, you're here! Would you help me?

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30120-03.htm.text: High Priest Maximilian: Nice to meet you, traveler. The grace of Einhasad has brought you here! I'm sorry you had to come here for nothing. (Only characters of level 45 or above may undertake this quest.)

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30120-04.html.text: High Priest Maximilian: Talk to Trader Gentler of the Town of Giran for more information.

Q00032_AnObviousLie/30120-02.html.text: High Priest Maximilian: I asked Trader Gentler of the Town of Giran to mix a batch of medicine for me, but he's having trouble acquiring some key ingredients. Help him find them.
